note: First sweep measured with the ANTIC AUTHORITY bit verified (0x06) at every chunk. 6502 reset was masking SALLYRST with & 2ul and silently dropping authority, so the retry path moved tests onto the legacy ANTIC mid-chunk (HANDOFF 1n) — run 2026-07-28-1 is invalid for that reason. Chunked with a JTAG reload per block, which keeps xexload load errors to one (cpu_65c816, which never halts by design). Identical to 2026-07-27-4: 33 pass, no gains, no losses. RTL since then (beam-time collision engine, cold-boot state clear, playfield byte stream, gtia_stream) is either inert or not yet exercised by these tests.
